jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Financial Partnerships
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role
Checkout.com is seeking a talented Senior Financial Partnerships Specialist in Riyadh to join the adventure and support our rapid growth and expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Working with a regional team, your main responsibility will be to manage and grow our partnerships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and card networks such as Visa, Mastercard and MADA. You will contribute to the development and execution of our strategy for such partnerships.

Reporting to the Head of Financial Partnerships - MENA, the successful candidate will be able to handle multiple projects and partnerships autonomously, have sufficient payments knowledge and experience to do so, and have a hands-on approach necessary in a fast growing start-up like ours. This is a great opportunity to contribute, learn and grow working on a broad range of projects in building a world-class payments infrastructure.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Manage commercial relationships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and grow Card Networks (including MADA) to develop and deliver market leading payment solutions for our merchants.

  • Drive expansion projects as required across geographies and payment methods in collaboration with a wider team.

  • Negotiate the most favorable operational and commercial outcomes for Checkout.com while balancing internal and external stakeholders

  • Ensure existing processes are followed and deliverables are met by both sides in a partnership. Design and develop new processes to scale those partnerships for growth, efficiency and performance improvement.

  • Collaborate effectively with various functions in the partner organization such as relationship management, business development, risk, compliance, product and operations across all levels.

  • Develop and execute a best-in-class partnership management model. Be the single point of contact internally and externally for assigned partnerships.

  • Use payments industry knowledge and experience to develop and execute strategies to support our growth with new products, services and market segments through partnerships.

  • Craft and implement win-win commercial agreements and go-to-market strategies with payment partners.

  • Leverage knowledge about the payments industry and partners’ capabilities to act as subject matter experts for internal teams.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years experience in payments.

  • Direct experience in payment processing, acquiring, or managing payment partnerships.

  • Proficient in payments knowledge, with the ability to problem solve or identify potential blockers within the payment flow and communicate these problems effectively to the wider teams.

  • Experience working with card networks or PSPs for acquiring payment transactions is a strong plus.

  • A mix of operations, project management, and relationship management skill set.

  • A strong sense of ownership to deliver business results with a focus on managing partner relationships.

  • Arabic speaking is MANDATORY for this role due to the relationships with local partners

  • Strong collaborator and communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders across organizations internally and externally.

  • Data-driven, analytical and strategic in problem solving issues and identifying opportunities to drive growth and efficiency.

  • Comfortable working across time zones and cultures in a globally distributed team.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Sales Manager - Saudi Arabia
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Job Description
We are seeking an elite Enterprise Sales Manager in Riyadh to bring our global payment infrastructure to Saudi Arabia’s largest enterprises. This is a rare opportunity for a relentless dealmaker to connect the Kingdom’s leading brands to the global digital economy. Backed by our world-class tech stack, you will drive complex, high-stakes contracts and be rewarded with an unrivalled, uncapped recurring commission structure.

🌍 The Role: Global Scale, Enterprise Impact

You will own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle, acting as a strategic advisor to C-level executives while collaborating with our global internal teams. You will:

  • Architect Global Growth: Identify, target, and conquer top-tier enterprise accounts, building a robust, high-value pipeline across key industries in the Saudi market.

  • Close High-Stakes Deals: Drive the adoption of our cutting-edge, cross-border payment solutions to major regional and global players through strategic executive networking, industry events, and direct outreach.

  • Own the Enterprise Cycle: Orchestrate complex, multi-layered enterprise sales cycles. Act as the trusted strategic advisor for prospective clients and the primary quarterback for internal global stakeholders.

  • Command the Room: Deliver compelling, data-driven pitches and highly tailored proposals that demonstrate exactly how Checkout.com's global capabilities solve complex local and international payment challenges.

  • Collaborate Globally: Partner seamlessly with cross-functional, global talent across Technology, Product, and Business teams to align our world-class architecture with the specific needs of Saudi enterprises.

  • Drive Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears on the ground, sharing critical business insights, competitive intelligence, and local market trends with our global leadership to shape future product and marketing strategies.

🏆 What You Bring to the Table

We are looking for an independent, high-achieving professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed, and highly competitive environment.

  • Enterprise Expertise: 6+ years of elite Enterprise/B2B Sales experience, successfully managing complex, high-value deal cycles. (Experience in the Payments or FinTech industry is a massive advantage).

  • Executive Network: A formidable, active network of C-level executives, enterprise prospects, and strategic partners across Saudi Arabia.

  • Global Business Acumen: A deep understanding of the global e-commerce landscape, cross-border financial factors, and the strategic drivers behind enterprise decision-making.

  • Technical Fluency: A genuine passion for disruptive technology. You possess the ability to articulate complex tech and payment architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical enterprise stakeholders.

  • Sales Execution: Exceptional executive-level communication and formidable negotiation techniques. Mastery of Salesforce and modern enterprise sales methodologies.

  • Unmatched Drive: Highly organized with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of prioritizing shifting workloads and consistently outperforming aggressive sales targets through personal drive.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager - Saudi Arabia
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

We are looking for strategic-thinking, resourceful, and highly driven Enterprise Account Managers to join our Commercial team in Riyadh. Come and help us shape the future of Payments in the Kingdom!

We are looking for top-tier payments talent to join our high-performance culture as we continue to scale after exponential growth in 2025, working with the biggest names in the region.

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you are the business advisor and primary post-integration point of contact. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping our largest merchants navigate the complex global payments landscape. You must possess the ability to influence C-level stakeholders, the analytical rigor to perform deep dives into payment performance, and the resilience to turn difficult conversations into win-win partnerships.

Candidates will be assessed against a specific set of criteria for each level (Mid & Senior) depending on their depth of payments experience and the competencies demonstrated throughout the interview process.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Driving Merchant ROI: Crafting and executing merchant-specific development plans that focus on tangible revenue generation and value-add.

  • Performance Optimization: Conducting deep-dive analyses of merchant payment data to increase acceptance rates, reduce false declines, and optimize the checkout flow.

  • Strategic Growth: Proactively identifying opportunities to upsell new products and features, increasing our "share of wallet" within each account.

  • Retention & Loyalty: Acting as the primary line of defense against churn by building high-touch, consultative relationships and resolving complex merchant pain points.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Navigating difficult conversations and handling pushback from sophisticated enterprise merchants with a focus on long-term partnership.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with Sales, Integration, Legal, and Product teams to ensure an outstanding, seamless merchant experience.

  • Market Advocacy: Acting as the voice of our product and an ambassador of our brand, providing expertise and guidance on global payment strategies.

 

About you:

  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience in a B2B Enterprise Account Management or Relationship Management role within a payments or digital first business!

  • Payments Expertise: Strong knowledge of e-commerce, payment technologies, and major future trends in the financial ecosystem.

  • Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to hit financial targets, reduce churn, and drive expansion revenue (upselling/cross-selling).

  • Resilience: Experience handling high-pressure situations and pushback from difficult or demanding enterprise stakeholders.

  • Analytical Mindset: Comfortable using data to tell a story; you can turn complex transaction data into actionable recommendations for a merchant.

  • Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and can manage multiple priorities without losing focus on performance.

  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills (Arabic is a plus), with the ability to influence at all levels of an external organization.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
